messages.subject: Averaging multiple brains
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dr. JefferisI am Takuro Ohashi, a postdoc at Nagoya University. I'm currently trying to create mosquito intersex brains with CMTK.
I found this webpage (https://github.com/jefferislab/MakeAverageBrain) which allows for averaging multiple brains.
However, this requires sungridEngine, which closed in 2016 so I couldn’t set it up.
Could you please tell me if you have developed later versions for averaging brains so that I can use in the latest OS? It would be very helpful for my research, thank you very much.Many thanks,
Takuro

messages.body_plain:
Dear Xiyang,

The error message is not very helpful, but I am afraid the problem is quite simple. The flycircuit database is down:

you will need to contact them to see if there is any timeline for putting it back up.

In the meantime you can get the data from neuromorpho but I am not sure about what space the SWC files are in

https://neuromorpho.org/MetaDataResult.jsp?count=23635&summary={%22neuron%22:{%22species%22:[%22drosophila%20melanogaster%22],%22archive%22:[%22Chiang%22]},%22ageWeightOperators%22:{},%22ageWeightOperations%22:{}} <https://neuromorpho.org/MetaDataResult.jsp?count=23635&summary=%7B%22neuron%22:%7B%22species%22:%5B%22drosophila%20melanogaster%22%5D,%22archive%22:%5B%22Chiang%22%5D%7D,%22ageWeightOperators%22:%7B%7D,%22ageWeightOperations%22:%7B%7D%7D>

Best wishes,

Greg.
